title: 5.6 Wants and Needs
unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
goal: Express affirmative and negative wants and needs, then describe what he, she and they want or need.
grammar_function: I want juice. I do not want milk. I need water. I do not need juice. He wants bread. She needs milk. They want chicken. They need some water.
prerequisite: 3.2 I; 1.1-1.3 he, she and they; 5.1-5.4 fruit, food, drinks and some.
speaking_outcome: Say what I want or need, and what someone else wants or needs.

cards.spanish_translation: Ellos necesitan un poco de agua.
Ellos necesitan un poco de agua.
